title: Nutty Mexican Corn Tacos
description: A nutty and crumbly Mexican dish featuring salted butter and wok-hei, inspired by the cuisine of Veracruz, with a low glycemic index.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pumpkin seeds and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Add the salted butter to the skillet and let it melt, stirring to combine with the pumpkin seeds.
Add the diced red onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the grilled corn kernels, chili powder, and a pinch of salt to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the corn and onion mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of crumbly cotija cheese and a squeeze of lime juice.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
